external_deps: OpenAI-compatible LLM API (OpenRouter, OpenAI or Ollama)

review.tagline: Self-hosted audio transcription with speaker labels, summaries and chat over recordings
review.summary: Speakr is a Flask and Vue web app that records or imports audio, transcribes it through a configurable engine (WhisperX, OpenAI, Mistral Voxtral, AssemblyAI and others), and generates summaries, titles and action items. It adds per-recording chat, semantic search across the library, tags with custom prompts, groups, OIDC SSO, a REST API and signed webhooks. Storage is SQLite by default or PostgreSQL.
review.audience: Teams and individuals wanting private meeting transcription on their own server
strengths: Many ASR connectors, auto-detected from config, including fully self-hosted WhisperX and VibeVoice
Speaker diarization and cross-recording voice profiles with the WhisperX backend
Multi-user with OIDC SSO, groups, sharing, retention policies and per-user usage budgets
REST API with Swagger UI and HMAC-signed webhooks for n8n, Zapier or Make
weaknesses: Voice profiles and WhisperX diarization need a separate ASR container with a GPU
Version is 0.10.14-alpha; the release is labeled alpha
Summaries and chat need an external LLM API key, or a local model such as Ollama
Full image is about 4.4GB; lite image falls back to basic text search
needs: Needs WhisperX ASR service (optional, GPU), OpenAI-compatible LLM API (OpenRouter, OpenAI or Ollama), SQLite or PostgreSQL
Models: WhisperX, OpenAI Transcribe, Mistral Voxtral, AssemblyAI, VibeVoice
